correctness.rationale: Sanità 2018 Theorem 4 supplies exact fractional vertex support decomposition; for each odd half-cycle a valid integral-matching rank inequality and Cauchy–Schwarz give a sharp 1/(4 length) squared-distance lower bound on mutually disjoint edge coordinates. Uniform averaging of all near-perfect cycle matchings realizes all bounds simultaneously and lies in matching polytope. Strict convexity gives unique vertex projection. Convexity of set distance proves the whole Hausdorff claim; inequality 1/length<=length/9 and disjointness prove universal bound and triangle-factor equality. Exact checker covers 1024 five-node graphs and 12 larger exemplars; finite checks not used as universal proof.

value.rationale: Calculates a natural Euclidean integer-hull error for the entire class of finite graphs and explicit projections at all fractional extreme points; ties the invariant exactly to reciprocal odd-cycle packing and sharply to triangle factors. It provides a structural geometric bridge between convex-hull approximation and an NP-complete graph partition decision, beyond routine code verification or arbitrary finite slices.
